line: Watch a river. It never stops, day or night. Neither does your time.
And while we keep saying 'later', life speeds right past us.
credit: Seneca · Letters to Lucilius 1, tr. Gummere

line: Too late? Midlife starters had nearly the same low death risk as lifelong movers.
credit: Saint-Maurice et al. · JAMA Netw Open, 2019

line: So move tomorrow's job to today, and today's job to right now.
Then shoot like you have one arrow. No second try. This one counts.
A cellist of 81 practised hours daily. Why? He felt he was still improving.
And yoga asks for balance: food, sleep, work, never too much or too little.
Can you get down to the floor and up easily? That predicted longer life.
credit: L. B. Brito et al. · Eur J Prev Cardiol, 2014

line: Not just longer. Real life is living in good health.
So, to all who practise: don't let your time flow past unused. Practise today.
